caption: Rocca di Camerino, Camerino
composition: Hilltop fortress above the Apennine town · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The fortress crowns the hilltop at the center of the frame, its long brick walls, square towers, and round bastion standing above the wooded slope, with the red-roofed town of Camerino spilling down to the lower left. Blue Apennine ridges layer across the background under a pale morning sky. At 08:23 the light is soft and clear, and the rocca's massive walls dominate the whole valley view.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Rocca di Camerino under clear morning light
